title: ScenarioRequest
description: A single lunar surface observer scenario. Public units: degrees, meters, UTC ISO 8601. Latitude is planetocentric; longitude is east-positive in [-180, 180). The body-fixed frame is chosen by the science service and reported in the response `model.body_fixed_frame`.

observer_height_m.description: Observer (e.g. antenna/panel) height above the local surface, meters. NOT a DEM elevation or a radius.

start_utc.description: Scenario start, UTC, ISO 8601 with a literal 'Z' suffix.

step_minutes.description: Sampling interval, minutes. Coarse sampling can miss short events; window edges are linearly interpolated between samples.

terrain_mode.description: 'ideal' = ideal geometric horizon (elevation 0 deg w.r.t. local reference plane). 'dem' = DEM-based terrain horizon (not available yet).
